resolved.title: 结构体方法Method
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Methods[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

We can add functionality to our structs using methods!
Methods are simply functions with a special [b]receiver argument[/b]. 
Let's have a look at an example:[code format="go" ]func (x Contact) welcome() {
  fmt.Println(x.name)
  fmt.Println(x.age)
} [/code]
The receiver appears between the [b]func[/b] keyword and the method name.
In the example above, the receiver is the [b]Contact[/b] struct.
[note]Note that we can access the receiver structs fields in the method.[/note]

resolved.title: 结构体方法Method
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Methods[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

In case we need to change the data of the struct in a method, we can use [b]pointers[/b] as method receivers. 

[s0l0!-header][b]For example:[/b][/s0l0!-header][code format="go" ]func (ptr *Contact) increase(val int) {
  ptr.age += val
}[/code]
Now our [b]increase[/b]() method uses a pointer as the receiver and is able to modify the [b]age[/b] field of the struct it is called on:[code format="go" codeId="3340"]x := Contact{"James", 42}
x.increase(8)
fmt.Println(x.age)[/code]
Go automatically dereferences the pointers, so we simply call the method with the struct name, just as we did with a simple receiver.
[note]Since methods often need to modify their receiver, pointer receivers are more common than value receivers. [/note]

resolved.title: 银行转账
resolved.problem_statement_md:
假设你正在开发一个银行应用程序。

示例代码中声明**BankAccount**结构体，且有余额字段`balance`。
你需要为`BankAccount`结构添加一个**withdraw**（）方法。它有一个整数参数，并按给定的金额减少银行账户的余额。

如果账户中没有足够的钱，该方法应该输出 "**余额不足**"。
resolved.problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Withdraw[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

You are working on a banking app. 

The code declares a [b]BankAccount[/b] struct with a [b]balance[/b] field. 
You need to add a [b]withdraw[/b]() method for the BankAccount struct. It should take an integer argument and decrease the balance of the Bank Account by the given amount.
In case there is not enough money in the account, the method should output "[b]Insufficient Funds[/b]".
[note]The code in [b]main[/b]() takes the amount to withdraw as input, and calls the [b]withdraw[/b]() method.[/note]
resolved.hint_md: **main**()中的代码输入金额，并调用**withdraw**()方法。
